sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_search" USING fts5(kind UNINDEXED, ref_id UNINDEXED, title, names, tokenize = 'unicode61');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "thumbnail_url" TEXT NULL, "liked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("liked" IN (0, 1)), "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "formats" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "itag" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "codecs" TEXT NULL, "bitrate" INTEGER NULL, "loudness_db" REAL NULL, "content_length" INTEGER NULL, "last_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "songs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "album_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES albums (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "thumbnail_url" TEXT NULL, "liked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("liked" IN (0, 1)), "total_play_time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "in_library" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_library" IN (0, 1)), "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL, "download_state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "file_size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_at" INTEGER NULL, "format_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES formats (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "unplayable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unplayable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_url" TEXT NULL, "liked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("liked" IN (0, 1)), "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "song_artists" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "artist_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES artists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("song_id", "artist_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_artists" ("album_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES albums (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "artist_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES artists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("album_id", "artist_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "browse_id" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_songs" ("playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("playlist_id", "song_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lyrics" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_lyrics" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("song_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "play_time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("query" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("query"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_items" ("position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_items" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "artist" TEXT NULL, "album" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "date_added" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cache_entries" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_accessed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_jobs" ("song_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES songs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quality" INTEGER NULL, "bytes_downloaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("song_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "shuffle_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shuffle_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "repeat_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX songs_title_idx ON songs (title)
CREATE INDEX songs_library_idx ON songs (in_library, date_added)
CREATE INDEX songs_played_idx ON songs (in_library, total_play_time_ms)
CREATE INDEX songs_unplayable_idx ON songs (unplayable)
CREATE INDEX albums_title_idx ON albums (title)
CREATE INDEX artists_name_idx ON artists (name)
CREATE INDEX song_artists_artist_idx ON song_artists (artist_id)
CREATE INDEX album_artists_artist_idx ON album_artists (artist_id)
CREATE INDEX playlist_songs_order_idx ON playlist_songs (playlist_id, position)
CREATE INDEX formats_song_idx ON formats (song_id)
CREATE INDEX play_events_song_idx ON play_events (song_id, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX play_events_recent_idx ON play_events (timestamp, id)
CREATE INDEX cache_entries_lru_idx ON cache_entries (last_accessed)
